subject: SDLC artifact catalog request for SIG scoping
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@veridian-assessors.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com
Cc: audit-team@veridian-assessors.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC artifact catalog for SIG scoping

Hi Priyom,

Hope you're well. I'm on the Veridian SIG intake team and we've kicked off the scoping pass for Redwood's SIG response. To keep the assessment on schedule we need a short "artifact catalog" listing where each requested secure-SDLC artifact lives and who owns it.

At a minimum we usually ask for:
- Code review evidence (PRs, approver list, sampling timeframe)
- CI/CD pipeline config + runner access model (where pipelines run, role accounts)
- Secrets management documentation (vaults, rotation cadence, approver workflow)
- Change control records for production releases (who approves, rollback playbook)
- Any relevant policy or runbook links

I've attached a short template (Veridian_request_template.xlsx) — filling the catalog table and returning the sheets is fine. If you can provide an ETA for an initial catalog (even if it's a pointer to an internal Drive folder with filenames), that would be ideal. Our target for the scoping pass is next Wednesday (2026-08-05).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30 min call if that helps.

Best,
Samira Khan
Senior Assessor
Veridian Assessors

Attachments: Veridian_request_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@veridian-assessors.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com, irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifact catalog for SIG scoping

Samira — thanks for the clear ask. We'll assemble an artifact catalog and return the filled template by EOD Monday (2026-08-02) so you have a working set well in advance of your 8/5 deadline.

Plan:
1) I'll own the catalog compilation and validate entries.
2) Jordan will pull sample PRs and the code-review sampling rationale.
3) Irene will export CI pipeline configs and a short note on runner isolation and service accounts.
4) We'll provide direct Drive links and a CSV manifest (artifact-index-template.csv) and flag anything that needs redaction.

Can you confirm whether you'd prefer full PR URLs or redacted snapshots? We typically share full links with external assessors under an expiring link, but can produce redacted exports if necessary.

I'll attach our working manifest once Jordan populates it.

— Priyom
Principal, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: artifact-index-template.csv (blank catalog)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifact catalog for SIG scoping

PRIYOM — attaching the first pass. I exported:
- PR samples (2026-06 sample set, 25 PRs) — folder: /drive/sdlc/PR-samples-202606.zip (access via expiring link)
- CI pipeline definitions (gitops repo: infra/ci/pipelines)
- Secret ownership map (vault paths and teams)

Short notes:
- Code review: default 2 approvers for prod-impacting repos; we have a sampling rationale document at the Drive link.
- CI: runners are in our dedicated subnets (no public runners), pipelines run on ephemeral runner instances controlled by a service account with scoped permissions.
- Secrets: main vault is HashiCorp Enterprise, rotation is automated for short-lived tokens; long-lived keys are restricted and rotated annually.

I've listed filenames in the attached sdlc-drive-manifest.csv and added owner@redwood for each item. If you need PR redactions, say the word and I'll export snapshots with commit hashes only.

Jordan
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdlc-drive-manifest.csv (15 KB)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@veridian-assessors.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com
Cc: audit-team@veridian-assessors.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC artifact catalog for SIG scoping

Thanks Priyom and Jordan — this is exactly what we needed. A couple of quick clarifications before we close the scoping loop: 

- PR links: expiring links with full URLs are fine for our intake; please set expiry >= 30 days.
- CI runner isolation: could you confirm whether runners are HSM-backed or use customer-managed HSM for signing artifacts (just a quick yes/no).
- Secrets: for the rotation cadence, will you include the automation logs for a 90-day window or just the policy statement?

If you can drop answers inline in the returned catalog, we'll mark the scoping ticket as closed. If any of these require an exception or redaction, please flag it in the manifest.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Samira
Veridian Assessors
